## 2. Technical Stack & Engineering Philosophy
- **Backend**: PHP 8.2+, Laravel, Custom MVC Frameworks, RESTful APIs, OOP, Clean Architecture.
- **Database**: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis caching, indexing & query optimization.
- **Frontend**: Modern Vanilla JS (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, TailwindCSS, Vue.js, React, Three.js 3D WebGL.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Cross-platform iOS & Android engineering.
- **AI & Automations**: Cloudflare Workers AI (Llama 3.1), OpenAI APIs, Webhook pipelines, Background Queues.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Apache, Nginx, cPanel, Cloudflare CDN/DNS/Workers, Docker, Git, CI/CD.

## 4. Notable Portfolio Projects & Deliverables

- **Case Summary**: Production-grade custom PHP and MySQL e-commerce platform built for a prominent UK vape retailer: featuring a custom admin visual theme builder, multi-dimensional product variant management, dynamic coupon engine, and complete order lifecycle tracking with zero Shopify transaction fees.

### Landsfy – Multi-Role Real Estate Marketplace & Property Portal
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/real-estate-property-portal-multi-role-marketplace
- **Case Summary**: National-scale PropTech marketplace and cross-platform Flutter mobile ecosystem custom-built with PHP 8, MySQL, AJAX Faceted Search, and Dart: connecting buyers, sellers, agents, and agencies across a 5-tier role hierarchy with automated approval pipelines, Google Maps clustering, and FCM lead capture.

### Chatrox – Real-Time Messaging & Enterprise Collaboration Platform
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/chatrox-real-time-messaging-professional-networking
- **Case Summary**: Real-time enterprise messaging and collaboration platform engineered with Laravel, WebSockets (Pusher/Socket.io protocol), Redis Pub/Sub, and MySQL: delivering encrypted 1-on-1 direct messages, role-governed team channels, live user presence, and media attachments without recurring per-seat SaaS costs.

### Workspace Kanban – Collaborative Agile Project Management Tool
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/workspace-kanban-project-task-management-platform
- **Case Summary**: High-performance team workspace and agile project management platform engineered with PHP 8, MySQL, Vanilla JavaScript Drag-and-Drop API, and WebSockets: delivering sub-50ms optimistic Kanban interactions, multi-role RBAC governance, and auditable task activity logs to replace Trello and Asana.

### HRM & Payroll Software – Employee Management Portal
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/hrm-employee-management-payroll-portal
- **Case Summary**: Enterprise HRM and payroll software engineered with Laravel 10, PHP 8, MySQL, and Redis: streamlining attendance tracking, multi-tier leave approval chains, tax-deductible salary automation, and real-time Chart.js workforce analytics for mid-size enterprises.

### Multi-Tenant CRM – Sales & Operations Platform
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/multi-tenant-crm-sales-operations-management-system
- **Case Summary**: High-concurrency enterprise B2B SaaS CRM engineered with Laravel, MySQL, and Redis: managing 1.5M+ active leads and 300+ concurrent sales agents across completely isolated tenant environments with automated lead routing, background bulk deduplication, and WebSocket team coordination.

### Ticketing CRM – Job & Vendor Management Enterprise Portal
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/ticketing-crm-jobs-vendor-management-enterprise-portal
- **Case Summary**: Enterprise field operations ticketing CRM engineered with Laravel: connects the full job lifecycle from intake to completion, featuring an automated cron SLA escalation engine, AJAX-powered vendor skill matching, and tamper-proof job-scoped conversation audit trails.

### Tour Guide Mobile App – Explore Pakistan Travel Companion
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/tour-guide-mobile-app-explore-pakistan-travel-solution
- **Case Summary**: Award-winning cross-platform travel companion app engineered as our Aptech team entry for the TechWiz Global Competition: features hyper-local geolocation intelligence via Google Maps, live OpenWeather API climate telemetry, zero-lag Firebase destination sync, and an administrative CMS for real-time travel alerts across Pakistan.

### Healink – Hospital & Medical Records Management App
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/healink-medicine-app-healthcare-hospital-management-solution
- **Case Summary**: Enterprise-grade healthcare ecosystem engineered in collaboration with medical industry professionals: connecting patients, doctors, hospitals, and pharmacies with real-time Firebase synchronization, end-to-end encrypted medical record vaults, and sub-millisecond prescription routing.

### Babyshop – Real-Time Retail E-Commerce Mobile App
- **URL**: https://amaanullah.com/projects/babyshop-mobile-app-ecommerce-firebase-solution
